<USER_REQUEST>
You are implementing surface friction + trap/switch integration + client presentation for P3 of Dungeon Haul.

START BY READING:
1. /Users/atarzwell/src/dhaul4/docs/components/simulation/DESIGN.md (§5.2 Surfaces, §8 Traps/switches)
2. /Users/atarzwell/src/dhaul4/docs/components/simulation/TASKS.md (C06-T16, C06-T17, C06-T18)
3. /Users/atarzwell/src/dhaul4/server/src/sim/kinematics.ts — current movement physics
4. /Users/atarzwell/src/dhaul4/server/src/sim/hazards.ts — Hazards class (already built)
5. /Users/atarzwell/src/dhaul4/server/src/sim/simulation.ts — current sim
6. /Users/atarzwell/src/dhaul4/packages/levels/src/ — LevelDefinition and CellType
7. /Users/atarzwell/src/dhaul4/client/src/scenes/GameScene.ts — current P2 dev scene
8. /Users/atarzwell/src/dhaul4/packages/protocol/src/core.ts — TreasurePublic, TrapPublic, etc.

YOUR TASKS:

## Part A: Surface Friction (C06-T16)
- Add surface type awareness to kinematics
- Create a pure helper `getSurfaceModifiers(cellType)` returning `{ frictionMultiplier, maxSpeedMultiplier }`
  - Ice: frictionMultiplier=0.3 (slides more), maxSpeedMultiplier=1.2
  - Sand: frictionMultiplier=2.0 (decelerates faster), maxSpeedMultiplier=0.7
  - Brick (default): both = 1.0
- Add an optional `surfaceModifiers?: { frictionMultiplier: number; maxSpeedMultiplier: number }` to MoveInput or as an extra param
- Modify stepHauler to apply these modifiers
- Create a `surfaceGridFromLevel` function similar to solidGridFromLevel that returns surface types per cell
- Write tests: ice slide distance > brick; sand max speed < brick

## Part B: Hazard Contact Helpers (C06-T17)
- In hazards.ts, add helper functions that can be called by the simulation:
  - `checkFloorHazard(cx, cy, hazards)` → returns the trap if grounded hauler is on a spike cell
  - `checkZoneHazards(body, hazards, bs)` → returns active zone traps overlapping the hauler
- These are already partially in hazards.ts (floorTrapAt, zoneTrapsOverlapping) — just ensure they work correctly
- Write tests for spike detection and lightning cycle active/inactive

## Part C: Switch Press Detection (C06-T18)
- Add to hazards.ts: `checkSwitchPresses(haulerPositions, hazards, blockSizePx)`
  - For each switch, check if any grounded hauler overlaps its cell
  - For heavy switches, sum the mass of all haulers on the cell
  - Update pressed state
- Write tests: light hauler fails heavy switch; 3 unloaded haulers succeed

## Part D: Client Presentation Updates (C02-T08, C02-T09)
Update /Users/atarzwell/src/dhaul4/client/src/scenes/GameScene.ts to show P3 elements:

### Treasure rendering:
- In update(), render free treasures from snapshot.treasures[] as small colored squares
  - 10x10 px, color by defId prefix or just white
- Render carried treasure as small dots stacked above hauler rects
- Show carry count in hauler label

### Trap/switch rendering:
- Render traps: spikes as red triangles, lightning as yellow rect when active
- Render switches: green circle when not pressed, red when pressed

### Stun visual:
- When hauler.stunned === true, draw flashing border around hauler rect

All rendering uses Phaser Graphics — no asset loading.

CRITICAL: Any changes to kinematics.ts must be backward compatible. The same kinematics exists at client/src/net/kinematics.ts — mirror changes there too.

Run server tests: cd /Users/atarzwell/src/dhaul4/server && pnpm test
Check client builds: cd /Users/atarzwell/src/dhaul4/client && pnpm run build
</USER_REQUEST>
